legal.termsObjectBody: These terms govern the use of the BOGBE'S GROUPE platform, a real estate intermediation service in Côte d'Ivoire.
legal.termsAccessBody: Access to the platform is free for renters. Owners wishing to publish listings can contact our team via WhatsApp.
legal.termsResponsibilitiesBody: BOGBE'S GROUPE acts as an intermediary. We verify the listings published but cannot guarantee the accuracy of all information provided by owners.
legal.privacyCollectionBody: We collect: name, email, phone, search preferences. No banking data is stored on our servers.
legal.privacyUseBody: Your data is used only to suggest relevant properties and to contact you. No sale to third parties.
legal.privacyRightsBody: You have the right to access, rectify and delete your data. Contact us via WhatsApp at
legal.privacyCookiesBody: We use cookies essential to site operation (authentication, preferences). No third-party advertising cookies.
